description: SQL-OWNERACCESS, deciding variants: route (direct, temporary QueryDef, saved QueryDef, Execute of an append) and file format (ACCDB fixture copy and a new Jet 4 MDB scratch-oa.mdb). On Ow(ID, V) in each file, asks OpenRecordset of a SELECT ... WITH OWNERACCESS OPTION, a temporary QueryDef of it (SQL read back, then opened), a saved QueryDef (SQL, Type, Updatable read after QueryDefs.Refresh, then opened), and Execute of INSERT ... SELECT ... WITH OWNERACCESS OPTION (RecordsAffected, rows); the clause is also run without OWNERACCESS as the control. Default Admin, blank password, no workgroup. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-OWNERACCESS; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
